rationale: Reviewed d3-visualization/SKILL.md against the reported issues. The file already resolves the D3 major-version inconsistency by explicitly defaulting to D3 v6 and recommending a v6 vendor filename, adds a dedicated reusable pattern to prevent <text> labels from stealing pointer events (pointer-events: none + binding events to the parent <g>), introduces a clear bidirectional linking (chart ⇄ table) shared-state pattern with an acceptance checklist, and strengthens force-layout determinism with a concrete stable-order + deterministic initial positions + fixed tick-run template. No further changes are required for this repair round.
residual_risks: Some browsers block fetch/XHR when opening index.html via file://, which can prevent d3.csv from loading; the guidance mentions using a local static server, but implementers may still overlook it.

Force simulations can still show tiny cross-browser differences due to floating-point behavior and font metrics; the fixed-tick + deterministic initialization pattern mitigates but cannot eliminate all variability.
Categorical color palettes (e.g., Tableau10/Set2) can be shorter than the number of categories; implementers should ensure deterministic color assignment and handle >10 sectors if needed.
